environment.description: Same application container image deployed on EKS 1.29 with Bottlerocket AMI nodes. Pod runs with a Kyverno-enforced securityContext (readOnlyRootFilesystem: false, but ephemeral volume for /app/uploads is an emptyDir with medium: Memory, sizeLimit: 10Mi). The pod's ServiceAccount has an IAM Role for Service Accounts (IRSA) binding that grants secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on a single secret ARN. AWS Secrets Manager automatic rotation is configured with a Lambda rotator (rotation interval: 60 seconds) that generates a new ACTIVE_API_KEY and patches the pod's environment via a sidecar secrets-store-csi-driver volume mount (SecretProviderClass with rotationPollInterval: 15s). The Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts egress from the pod to only the Secrets Manager VPC endpoint and denies all ingress except from the internal ALB target group. The ALB has a listener rule that inspects multipart/form-data requests and drops any request where Content-Disposition filename ends in .sh, .php, .jsp, .exe, .bat, .cmd, .ps1, .elf, or contains path traversal sequences (../ or ..\). Additionally, the emptyDir memory-backed volume means uploaded files exist only in RAM and are lost on pod restart (which occurs every 300s via a CronJob-triggered rollout).

config.secrets_rotation: AWS Secrets Manager, 60s rotation, CSI driver sync every 15s
config.network_policy: deny-all-ingress except ALB target group, deny-all-egress except Secrets Manager VPCE
config.alb_rule: drop multipart with dangerous extensions or path traversal in filename
